## What it is

WeGoTrip sells this as a self-guided tour in Rome, Italy. It starts at Piazza di Santa Maria Maggiore.

## How WeGoTrip describes it

> When you visit the Basilica of Santa Maria Maggiore, you will discover much more than just the Dome, you can also explore the Blessing Loggia, the Hall of Popes, and Gian Lorenzo Bernini's Staircase.
>
> Wonder at the intricate mosaics, centuries-old frescoes, and the architectural beauty of one of Rome's major basilicas. Don't miss the Crypt of the Nativity and the relic of the Holy Crib, believed to be part of the manger where Jesus was laid.

## Price and rating

On 13 November 2026, WeGoTrip's product data listed it from €13.75. It was rated 3.8 out of 5 from 100 ratings and 45 written reviews. The final price is shown at WeGoTrip's checkout.

## Where this page comes from

This page was built on 13 November 2026 from WeGoTrip's partner data, the product information WeGoTrip gives its affiliates. We have not taken this tour ourselves, so check the listing for anything that matters to you before you book.
